objective: Provide a reusable date-formatting helper so any part of the codebase can render a date as DD/MM/YYYY consistently, instead of each call site hand-rolling its own formatting (which today does not exist anywhere: a search for "format" in frontend/src returns no matches). Without it, every future date display risks inconsistent day/month ordering and missing zero-padding.
outcomes: A new format.ts exists at the agreed location, containing an exported date-formatting function.
Given 2024-03-05 (5 March 2024), the helper returns the string "05/03/2024" (zero-padded day and month).
The helper accepts the input type(s) the developer confirms (Date object and/or ISO string).
The file type-checks under the workspace tsconfig with no new lint errors.

evidence.excerpt: Add a utility helper function in a new file utils/format.ts to format dates as DD/MM/YYYY.
Listed repo root: there is no top-level utils/ directory. Candidate homes are frontend/src/lib/ (has utils.ts) and backend/core/src/utils/ (git.ts, home.ts, id.ts, markdown.ts).

In frontend/, only the chat page (frontend/src/app/chat, frontend/src/components/chat, frontend/src/lib/chat-client.ts) is live. Do not change the other dashboard pages unless the developer explicitly asks; they still run on mock data.
Existing frontend util is frontend/src/lib/utils.ts exporting cn(); it imports via the @/* alias. Frontend tsconfig maps @/* to ./src/*.
Frontend package has no test script or test runner (only dev/build/start/lint). Vitest is configured for backend/core, backend/server and mcp; root test script filters those three packages only.
AGENTS.md conventions: ESM throughout, relative TS imports use the .js suffix, and tests are added next to the changed package (backend/<pkg>/test).
Request names "utils/format.ts" but no such directory exists at the repo root; the target location is ambiguous and must be confirmed by the developer.

edgeCases.scenario: Invalid date input (e.g. new Date("nonsense") or an unparseable string)
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Developer to confirm: return an empty string, return "Invalid Date", or throw. Not assumed.

edgeCases.scenario: Day or month is a single digit (e.g. 9 January 2024)
Date near midnight in different timezones
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Developer to confirm whether to format in local time or UTC — affects the resulting day.
Developer to confirm: rely on TypeScript's type check only, or add a runtime guard.

Do not add new runtime dependencies (no date library); use the platform Date API.
Do not change existing dashboard pages in frontend/ — only the chat page is live per AGENTS.md.

pnpm build and pnpm lint keep passing.

Confirm the output for a known date, e.g. 2024-03-05 -> "05/03/2024", via a unit test or a manual run.
Run pnpm test to confirm no existing tests regress.
Run pnpm run lint and pnpm run build.
